provider: USGS NWIS via Water Quality Portal
license_note: Public data service; check source terms and record-level qualifiers before republication.

datasets.role: Raw result records for the existing empirical uranium reference baseline
Station coordinates and reported location/well/aquifer metadata

processing.filter: ActivityMediaName=Water; ActivityMediaSubdivisionName=Groundwater; characteristic Uranium; nonnegative numeric ResultMeasureValue; reported unit µg/L
limitations: Repeated site records are not independent experimental samples.
Methods, qualifiers, detection limits, periods, and aquifers vary.
Station coordinates do not establish groundwater flow direction or ISR connectivity.
